//: Lighthouse CI budgets (plan/01 §7, spec 004 AC-24). JSON has no comments, so this key is the
note; `@lhci/cli` reads `.ci` and ignores everything beside it.
`resource-summary:script:size` is **transfer** size, i.e. the bytes on the wire after content
encoding. Vercel serves Brotli, so 122 880 here means 120 KB Brotli — which is what spec 004
§13 Q13 restated the plan/01 §7 budget as (founder decision, 2026-09-08, option (a)), and what
`pnpm budget:client-js` now compares against. Before that restatement this number was read as
gzip in the repository and as Brotli by Lighthouse, and the same build was 'over' or 'under'
`categories:seo` is collected but deliberately **not** asserted: every page in Phase 0 is
`noindex` (ADR-0007, spec 001 §6), so the SEO category would score the robots directive rather
than the page, and nobody should be able to make a number green by indexing early. Spec 007
asserts it when there is an indexable set. AC-24 (TASK-056) owns the enforcement flip and the
five-URL set; TASK-046 owns these numbers being achievable.
